// @molis-ai/molis-work-plugin-feed/contract: public API snapshot.
// Generated by `node scripts/gates/api-snapshot.mjs --update`; do not edit by hand. A change below is a change to what plugins and other callers can use:
// say what it means for them in the PR.

export declare const FEED_CONTENT_REPLICA_ID = "feed_content";

export interface FeedApi {
    readonly query: FeedQuery;
    readonly commands: FeedCommands;
    readonly events: FeedEvents;
}

export interface FeedAttentionRequest {
    reason: Extract<AttentionReason, "manual" | "source_rule">;
    detail?: Record<string, unknown>;
}

export interface FeedCommands {
    ingest(input: IngestFeedItemInput): {
        item: FeedItemRecord;
        created: boolean;
        updated: boolean;
    };
    upsertMaterial(material: FeedMaterialRecord): FeedMaterialRecord;
    setDisposition(projectId: string, itemId: string, disposition: FeedItemDisposition, expectedRevision?: number): FeedItemRecord;
    restore(projectId: string, itemId: string, expectedRevision?: number): FeedItemRecord;
    markRead(projectId: string, itemId: string): FeedItemRecord;
    linkGoal(projectId: string, itemId: string, goalId: string, disposition: "promoted"): FeedItemRecord;
    deleteBySource(projectId: string, sourceId: string): number;
}

export interface FeedEvent {
    event_id: string;
    project_id: string;
    item_id: string;
    type: "feed_item.created" | "feed_item.updated" | "feed_item.read" | "feed_item.restored" | "feed_item.saved" | "feed_item.promoted" | "feed_item.archived" | "feed_item.inbox" | "feed_item.deleted";
    payload: Record<string, unknown>;
    at: string;
}

export interface FeedEvents {
    list(projectId: string, itemId?: string): FeedEvent[];
}

export type FeedItemDisposition = "inbox" | "saved" | "promoted" | "archived";

export interface FeedItemRecord {
    project_id: string;
    item_id: string;
    source_id: string | null;
    signal_id: string | null;
    signal_revision: number | null;
    kind: string;
    title: string;
    summary: string;
    body: string | null;
    source_kind: string;
    source_label: string;
    external_id: string | null;
    url: string | null;
    origin_status: string;
    priority: string;
    tags: string[];
    author: string | null;
    disposition: FeedItemDisposition;
    linked_goal_id: string | null;
    read_at: string | null;
    revision: number;
    source_created_at: string;
    source_updated_at: string;
    imported_at: string;
    updated_at: string;
    materials: FeedMaterialRecord[];
}

export interface FeedMaterialRecord {
    project_id: string;
    material_id: string;
    item_id: string;
    canonical_url: string | null;
    title: string;
    source_name: string;
    published_at: string | null;
    preview: string;
    content_hash: string | null;
    content_ref: string | null;
    content_available: boolean;
    content_type: string | null;
    character_count: number | null;
    captured_at: string | null;
    provenance: Record<string, unknown>;
    selected_for_context: boolean;
    imported_at: string;
    updated_at: string;
}

export interface FeedModuleDependencies {
    attention: AttentionApi;
}

export interface FeedQuery {
    list(projectId: string, page: FeedItemPage): FeedItemRecord[];
    get(projectId: string, itemId: string, materials?: {
        offset: number;
        limit: number;
    }): FeedItemRecord;
    materials(projectId: string, itemId: string, offset: number, limit: number): FeedMaterialRecord[];
    hasPackage(projectId: string, sourceId: string, externalId: string, hash: string): boolean;
    facets(projectId: string): {
        source_id: string;
        label: string;
        count: number;
    }[];
    exists(projectId: string, itemId: string): boolean;
    countBySource(projectId: string, sourceId: string): number;
    findByLinkedGoal(projectId: string, goalId: string, itemId?: string): FeedItemRecord | null;
}

export interface IngestFeedItemInput {
    project_id: string;
    source_id: string;
    source_kind: string;
    source_label: string;
    external_id: string;
    signal?: {
        signal_id: string;
        revision: number;
    };
    refresh?: boolean;
    title: string;
    summary: string;
    body?: string | null;
    url?: string | null;
    kind?: string;
    priority?: string;
    tags?: string[];
    author?: string | null;
    occurred_at: string;
    attention?: false | FeedAttentionRequest;
    material?: Omit<FeedMaterialRecord, "project_id" | "item_id" | "imported_at" | "updated_at">;
}

export interface ListenerCheckpoint {
    project_id: string;
    source_id: string;
    cursor: unknown;
    state: "idle" | "listening" | "retry_wait" | "quarantined";
    attempt: number;
    retry_at: string | null;
    last_error_code: string | null;
    updated_at: string;
}

export interface ListenerHostApi {
    readonly connector: ConnectorHostApi;
    checkpoint(projectId: string, sourceId: string): ListenerCheckpoint;
    getRunByOperationId(projectId: string, operationId: string): ListenerRunRecord | null;
    listRuns(projectId: string): ListenerRunRecord[];
    recoverInterruptedRuns(projectId: string): number;
    run(input: {
        project_id: string;
        source_id: string;
        connection_id: string;
        operation_id: string;
        adapter: RawEventAdapter;
        intent?: Record<string, unknown>;
        signal?: AbortSignal;
        beforeEffect?(): Promise<void>;
    }): Promise<ListenerRunReceipt>;
}

export interface ListenerRunReceipt extends ListenerRunRecord {
    replayed: boolean;
    accepted: Array<{
        event: ConnectorRawEvent;
        receipt: SignalReceipt;
    }>;
}

export interface ListenerRunRecord {
    run_id: string;
    operation_id: string;
    project_id: string;
    source_id: string;
    phase: "running" | "terminal" | "interrupted";
    outcome: string | null;
    created_count: number;
    deduped_count: number;
    recovery_count: number;
    empty: boolean;
    error_code: string | null;
    connector_receipt: Record<string, unknown> | null;
    started_at: string;
    completed_at: string | null;
    updated_at: string;
}

export interface MissedPullRecord {
    run_id: string;
    source_id: string;
    title: string;
    due_at: string;
    missed_at: string;
    decision: "run_now" | "skip" | null;
}

export declare const SIGNAL_CONTENT_REPLICA_ID = "signals_content";

export declare const SOURCE_CONTENT_REPLICA_ID = "sources_content";

export interface SignalAdapterRef {
    plugin_id: string;
    version: string;
}

export interface SignalCommands {
    submitDraft(draft: SignalDraft): SignalReceipt;
    deleteBySource(projectId: string, sourceId: string): void;
}

export interface SignalDraft {
    project_id: string;
    source_id: string;
    provider_dedupe_id: string;
    kind: string;
    occurred_at: string;
    observed_at: string;
    payload: Record<string, unknown>;
    content_refs?: string[];
    raw_event_id: string;
    adapter: SignalAdapterRef;
    provenance: Record<string, unknown>;
}

export interface SignalEvent {
    event_id: string;
    project_id: string;
    signal_id: string;
    source_id: string;
    type: "signal.accepted" | "signal.changed";
    revision: number;
    at: string;
}

export interface SignalEvents {
    list(projectId: string, sourceId?: string, page?: SignalPage): SignalEvent[];
}

export interface SignalPage {
    limit?: number;
    offset?: number;
}

export interface SignalQuery {
    get(projectId: string, signalId: string): SignalRecord;
    list(projectId: string, sourceId?: string, page?: SignalPage): SignalRecord[];
}

export interface SignalReceipt {
    signal: SignalRecord;
    created: boolean;
    changed: boolean;
    deduped: boolean;
}

export interface SignalRecord extends SignalDraft {
    signal_id: string;
    revision: number;
    content_hash: string;
    validation: "accepted";
    superseded_by: string | null;
    withdrawn_at: string | null;
    created_at: string;
    updated_at: string;
}

export interface SignalsApi {
    readonly query: SignalQuery;
    readonly commands: SignalCommands;
    readonly events: SignalEvents;
}

export interface SourceCommands {
    save(source: SourceRecord): SourceRecord;
    setEnabled(projectId: string, sourceId: string, enabled: boolean, at?: string): SourceRecord;
    retire(projectId: string, sourceId: string, historyDecision: SourceHistoryDecision, at?: string): SourceRecord;
}

export interface SourceEvent {
    event_id: string;
    project_id: string;
    source_id: string;
    type: "source.created" | "source.updated" | "source.status_changed" | "source.retired";
    payload: Record<string, unknown>;
    at: string;
}

export interface SourceEvents {
    list(projectId: string, sourceId?: string): SourceEvent[];
}

export type SourceHistoryDecision = "retain_history" | "delete_local_history";

export interface SourceMissedPulls {
    record(projectId: string, entry: Omit<MissedPullRecord, "decision">): void;
    list(projectId: string, limit: number): MissedPullRecord[];
    get(projectId: string, runId: string): MissedPullRecord | null;
    decide(projectId: string, runId: string, decision: "run_now" | "skip", at: string): void;
}

export interface SourceQuery {
    list(projectId: string): SourceRecord[];
    get(projectId: string, sourceId: string): SourceRecord;
    find(projectId: string, syncKind: SourceSyncKind, definitionId: string | null, configFingerprint?: string): SourceRecord | null;
}

export interface SourceRecord {
    project_id: string;
    source_id: string;
    kind: string;
    definition_id: string | null;
    sync_kind: SourceSyncKind;
    name: string;
    description: string;
    status: SourceStatus;
    enabled: boolean;
    origin: "molis_work";
    config: Record<string, unknown>;
    schedule: SourceSchedule;
    connection_ref: string | null;
    account_label: string | null;
    last_sync_at: string | null;
    last_outcome: string | null;
    last_error_code: string | null;
    imported_at: string;
    updated_at: string;
}

export type SourceSchedule = {
    mode: "manual";
} | {
    mode: "interval";
    enabled: boolean;
    interval_minutes: number;
    next_pull_at: string | null;
};

export type SourceStatus = "active" | "paused" | "error" | "disconnected";

export type SourceSyncKind = "public_source" | "github" | "gmail" | "connector" | "manual";

export interface SourcesApi {
    readonly query: SourceQuery;
    readonly commands: SourceCommands;
    readonly events: SourceEvents;
    readonly missed: SourceMissedPulls;
}

export declare function isAccountConnectorSyncKind(kind: string): kind is Extract<SourceSyncKind, "github" | "gmail" | "connector">;

export declare function sourceDeletedAt(source: Pick<SourceRecord, "config">): string | null;

// Declarations the exports above refer to, which no entry exports itself:

interface FeedItemPage {
    limit: number;
    offset: number;
    source_id?: string;
    item_id?: string;
    after_id?: string;
    search?: string;
    status?: FeedItemDisposition | "active" | "all";
    unread?: boolean;
    since?: string;
    provider?: string;
    source_label?: string;
    sort?: "newest" | "oldest" | "title" | "source" | "id";
}
